description: Resolve DNS records for a domain via DNS-over-HTTPS (1.1.1.1): A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT (SPF/verification), CNAME, CAA, SOA, SRV, HTTPS, DS, DNSKEY. Returns values with TTLs, whether the domain exists (NXDOMAIN) and whether the answer was DNSSEC-validated.

types.description: Comma-separated record types (default A,AAAA,MX,NS,TXT,CNAME,CAA,SOA). Also SRV,HTTPS,DS,DNSKEY,PTR

name: dns_lookup
title: DNS lookup (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CAA, SOA...)
